items.text: Koncheng’ei bik ole bartoi Jesu
Ak kingobata betusiek aeng’u kobiit igortab paska ak makatinik che ma kinde mermerek: ak kicheng’ tisiik che eechen ak sirik ole imuktoi konam eng’ ng’alset, si kobiit kobar inendet:
amu kile icheget, Amat ongenam eng’ igorta, si mabolyo bik.
Kerong’jin mwaita Jesu eng’ Betania

Ak ye kimi inendet Betania eng’ gotab Simon ne kiamei mogondosik, kota kotebyei eng’ amisiet, konyo kobogoriot ne tinyei chubait ne mi mwaita ne nyamdut ne bo kamanutiet ne o; ak kotui chubainato, ak korong’ji metinnyi.
Ak kimi alage che kinerektos eng’ orit kolen, Amu nee si kibeet buch mwai?
Amu kata yamei kealdae mwai che siirei denarisiek bogol somok, ak kigochi kibananok. Ak kiing’unyng’ung’ji inendet.
Ago kile Jesu, Obagakte; kalya si oiim inendet? Kayaiywa boisiet ne mie.
Amu otinye kotugul kibananok, ak eng’ ui tugul ye omache, omuchi oyachi ne mie: ago mami ane kotugul kobotok.
Kagoyai ne imuchi: kasib koiil bortanyu agobo tubet.
Ak amwawok iman ale, Ui tugul ole kiamjin logoiywek che miach eng’ ng’ony komugul, kemwaitoi agine ne kayai kobogoriondoni si kobiit koek kabwatet agobo inendet.
Chaamset ne kichaame Judas Jesu
Ak kiwa Judas Iskariot, ne ki age eng’ taman ak aeng’, ole mi tisiik che eechen, si kobiit kong’wekyi icheget.
Ak kingab kagas ichek, koboiboitu, ak koarorji kole, kogochi fedaisiek. Ak kicheng’ sait ne yamei si kong’wekta inendet.
Igorta ne bo let
Ak eng’ betut ne bo tai ne bo makatinik che ma kinde mermerek, ye kienyei aruetab paska, kolenji alamalyennyi, Imache kebe ano si kechobun ole iame paska?
Ak kiiyokto aeng’ che bo alamalyennyi, kolenji, Oba nganaset, ak otuiye chito ne ibu teretab beek: osub inendet;
ak oldo tugul ole mong’jin inendet, olenji chitab kobo got, Kale Konetindet, Mi ano gonnyu ne bo toek, ole anyone aame igortab paska koboto alamalyennyu?
Ak koboruok inendet got ne o ne bo barak ne tetat tuguk, ak ko chobot: ak ochobwech oloto.
Kiba anyun alamalyet, kot koit nganaset, konyor ko u ye kaga kemwachi: ak kichob anyun paska.
Ak kingoek koskoleny konyo koboto taman ak aeng’.
Ak ye kitebyei eng’ amisiet, kole Jesu, Amwawok iman, ale, Ng’wektoa age eng’ okwek, inendet ne kiamisiei tuwai.
Kotoi anyun koarogenso, ak kolenji inendet agenge agenge, Tos ane?
Ak kilenji ichek, Noto ko agenge eng’ taman ak aeng’, ne kiburburtoi tuwai eng’ tabet.
Amu wendi Weritab chi, ko u ye sirat agobo inendet: ago bwa eng’ chichoto king’wektae Weritab chi! Kita mie eng’ chichoto ko ma kisich.
Ak ye kiamisiei icheget, konam makatiat, ak kingo kagoberur, kobutul, ak kogochi, ak kole, Onam: ni ko bortanyu.
Ak kinam kikombet, ak kingo kagomwa kongoi, kogochi ichek: ak koee tugul.
Ak kilenji, Chu korotikyuk che bo arorutiet, che tumdogei agobo che chang’.
Amwawok iman ale, Ma aee kogeny che bo logoekab sabibuk, agoi betunoto ne aee che leelach eng’ bounatetab Jehovah.
Ak kingo kagotien tiendo, komanda koba tulwet ne bo Emitik.
Sib komwaei Jesu kole bagaktoi alamalyet inendet
Kolenji Jesu ichek, Kinachok okwek tugul: amu kigisir kele, Abire mestowot, ak koiyesta kechirek.
Ago, ye kaging’eeta, andoenak awe Galili.
Ago kilenji Petero, Agot nginach tugul agobo inye, ko maginacha.
Ak kilenji Jesu inendet, Amwaun iman ale, rani, kemouni, kotom kote kipsoiywet konyil aeng’, iesioa konyil somok.
Ak kimwa eng’ kimnatet ne o kole, Ngo nyolu kebegu tuwai, ko magoi aesien. Ak kimwa agichek tugul ko u noto.
Jesu eng’ Getsemane
Ak kiit koret ne kiguure Getsemane, ak kilenji alamalyennyi, Otebe yu, ye asae.
Ak kiimut Petero ak Jakobo ak Johana, ak kotoi kokwong’io mising’ ak koarogenso.
Ak kilenji ichek, Kaarogen sobondanyu mising’ agoi meet: otebe yu ak oripse.
Ak kiwa tai kitigin, ak kobutyi ng’ony, ak kosa kole, ngomugaksei, ko mie kosiirtoena sainito.
Ak kimwa kole, Aba, Baba, imugaksei tuguk tugul eng’ inye; istaena kikombani: ago, ma ko u ye amache, ago ko u ye imache.
Ak kinyo ak konyor ichek koruitos, ak kolenji Petero, Simon, irue? Ma imuch iripse agot sait agenge?
Oripse ak osae, si mochut yomset: chamei tamirmiriet iman, ago nyaluli borto.
Ak kiwa kogeny, ak kosa komwa ng’alechugaita.
Ak kinyo kogeny, ak konyor koruitos, amu kiga nyigisitu mising’ konyekwak; ak kima kongen kit ne woljin inendet.
Ak kinyo ne bo somok, ak kolenji ichek, Oruiye anyun nguno, omuuny: kagoyam; kagoit sait; ogeero, kageng’wekyi Weritab chi eunekab kiptengeginik.
Ong’eetye, kebe: ogeero, kagorik inendet ne ng’wektaa.
Kenamei Jesu
Ak ngunoto, kota kong’alali, konyo Judas, age eng’ taman ak aeng’, koboto tuiyet che tinyei rotokab chok ak siarisiek, kobunu ole mi tisiik che eechen ak sirik ak boisiek.
Ak kiga koarorji ng’wektaindet ichek, kolenji, Inendet ne ang’ututi ko inendet noto; onam, ak omut ak oribote.
Ak kingoit, kwo eng’ sainato ole mi inendet, ak kole, Rabbi; ak kong’utut.
Ak kiiyogoito bichoto eunekwak ak konam inendet.
Ago king’us rotwennyi bo chok age eng’ che kitonondos eng’ ye negit, ak koeb ititab otwogindetab tisiindet ne o.
Ak kiwolji Jesu kolenji, Komong’u ak rotokab chok ak siarisiek, ko u ye osetyini rebindet, si onama?
Kiami kobotok betusiek tugul eng’ hekalut anetisiei, ak kima onama: ago kayaak ni si kobiit kosulda sirutik.
Ak kibagakta ichek tugul inendet, ak komwei.
Ak kiisub inendet mureno age, ne kiilaachi anget inegei ne bo katanit, ak konam bichoto inendet;
ak kometo ngorionoto bo katanit, komwei ach ngor.
Kimuti Jesu taitab tisiindet ne o
Kiimut Jesu anyun kwo ole mi tisiindet ne o: ak koyumjigei inendet tisiik tugul che eechen ak boisiek ak sirik.
Ak kiisub Petero inendet eng’ ye loo, agoi koit seremutab gotab tisiindet ne o; ak kitebyei koboto ng’atik, koyue mat.
Kicheng’ anyun tisiik che eechen ak kapkiruoget komugul baornatet eng’ Jesu si kobiit kobar; ago kimanyor.
Amu kibaorianji che chang’ lembech agobo inendet, ak ma namgei baornatenywa.
Ak kitononso alak, kobaorian lembech agobo inendet, kole,
Kigegas komwaei inendet kolen, Ang’eme hekaluni kigiyae eunek, ak ateech age eng’ betusiek somok ne magiyae eunek.
Agot eng’ noto ko ma namgei baornatenywa.
Kitonon anyun tisiindet ne o eng’ kwenunywa, koteebe Jesu, kole, Mewolu kiy? Nee ni baorianjinin bichu?
Ago kisis, ama wol kiy. Kiteebe kogeny tisiindet ne o, kole, I Kristo inye, Weritab Ne Iberurot?
Ak kile Jesu, A inendet: ak tun ogeere Weritab chi kotebyei eng’ eutab tai ne bo kamuktaet, konyonei eng’ bolik che bo kipsengwet.
Ak kigerer ngoroikyik tisiindet ne o, kolen, Ta kemage nee baorinik alak?
Kaogas ng’alek che yaach che mwaei: obwati nee? Ak kiiruokyi tugul kole nyoljin meet.
Ak kitoi alak kosing’ilji inendet, ak kotuch togennyi, ak koluch, ak kolenji, Ng’orse: ak kinam ng’atik inendet ak korabach.
Kotiitos Petero Jesu
Ak kingota komi Petero seremut ole bo ng’ony, konyo age eng’ tibik che otwogikab tisiindet ne o;
ak kingogeer Petero koyue mat, kochiilji kong’ inendet, ak kolenji, Kiimi aginye koboto Nasaretindonoto, Jesu.
Ago kitiiyo kole, Mangen, amaguitosi choto imwae: ak komanda kwo keter; ak kiito anyun kipsoiywet.
Ak kigeer cheboto inendet, ak kotoi kogeny komwachi che tonondos eng’ ye negit, kolenji, Ni ko agenge eng’ icheget.
Ak kitiiyo kogeny. Ak ne matia kolenji ichek kogeny che kitonondos eng’ ye negit Petero, Iman i agenge eng’ ichek amu i Galilindet.
Ak kitoi kochubis, ak koyosio, kole, Mangen chichi omwae.

Ak ngunoto kote kipsoiywet ne bo aeng’. Ak kiibwat anyun Petero ng’olyondonoto, ko u ye kiga komwachi Jesu inendet kole, Kotom kote kipsoiywet konyil aeng’, iesioa konyil somok. Ak kingobwat ng’olyondonoto, korir.
